fact: The National Audit Office's report on the 2024/25 audit of ICT systems in 133 public institutions notes the institutions' heavy dependence on external ICT service providers, and finds 44 received ICT services from them without formal contracts.
title: Ripoti Kuu ya Mwaka ya Ukaguzi wa Mifumo ya TEHAMA kwa Mwaka wa Fedha 2024/25
publisher: Ofisi ya Taifa ya Ukaguzi (Controller and Auditor General)
